A faithful, photorealistic reproduction of Auguste Rodin's bronze sculpture The Thinker (Le Penseur), shown as a single centred subject in a square 1:1 composition. The muscular nude male figure sits hunched on a rock, leaning forward, his right elbow resting on his left thigh, his chin supported on the back of his right hand, brow furrowed in deep concentration. His left hand rests on his left knee, toes gripping the rock edge, back muscles taut and twisted. The bronze has a dark green-brown patina with subtle golden highlights on raised muscles and a rough, hand-modelled surface. The statue stands on a low grey stone plinth in the quiet garden of the Musée Rodin in Paris, with soft overcast daylight, clipped green hedges and pale gravel behind, gently blurred. Because the original is tall and narrow, extend the soft garden background naturally on both left and right, keeping the whole sculpture visible without stretching. No people, no frame, no plaque, no text, no signature. Fix: Garden background with topiary, gravel path, distant wall and stone pedestal visible; not a plain background.

A faithful photographic reproduction of Michelangelo's marble sculpture Pietà (1498–1499), St. Peter's Basilica, Vatican City, composed as a square 1:1 image with the sculpture centred and fully visible. The Virgin Mary sits on a rough rocky mound, her head gently bowed, her serene young face framed by a veil. She wears heavy, deeply carved drapery that falls in rich cascading folds over her lap and legs. Across her knees lies the lifeless body of the adult Christ, his head and arm hanging back, his torso softly modelled with anatomical precision. Her left hand is open in a quiet gesture of sorrow and offering. The pyramidal composition is rendered in smooth, polished white Carrara marble with a soft luminous glow and subtle warm highlights. The background is a plain, softly darkened blue-grey chapel niche, with the sides extended naturally and evenly so the sculpture is not stretched or squashed. No frame, plaque, caption, signature, glass panel or other people appear. Fix: Image 2 shows a pedestal base and a dark blue wall with columns, not a plain background. The marble is similar in colour to the original.
